items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly says two overlapping deliveries both check before either handler finishes and therefore execute the handler twice.
Gap 2 says de-duplication uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header and explains how changing it on a valid signed body bypasses the check.
Gap 3 states that the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered for refund.created, causing real refunds to be dropped.
None of the gaps depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
